title: Callout
description: A bubble with a short text that points at a point of the picture (a tail from the bubble, or a leader line with a dot), popping in with an eased scale. The point is in the picture's pixels; the bubble stays inside the safe area and flips to the other side when it would leave it. Text sizes are a share of the frame's short side, with a floor. Place it with the same transform as the footage it annotates; pairs with kit-cursor, kit-arrow and kit-spotlight. Takes a theme.

text.description: *Asterisks* mark words in the accent colour; \n breaks a line

point.description: What it points at, in the picture's pixels

space.description: Size of the picture the point refers to (a recording's pixels)

fit.description: How the picture sits in the item box (as the footage item's fit)

side.description: Which side of the point the bubble sits on; it flips when that would leave the safe area

style.description: A speech-bubble tail, or a line with a dot on the point

size.description: Text size in % of the frame's short side

maxWidth.description: Widest the bubble gets, in % of the safe width

gap.description: Distance from the point to the bubble, in % of the frame's short side

plate.description: Bubble colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's surface)

ink.description: Text colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's ink)

accent.description: Border, line and *emphasis* colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent)

author: claude-opus-5-5
